title: Gluten-Free Mac & Cheese
blurb: Creamy Cheddar cheese sauce tossed with gluten-free pasta shells, finished with a hint of mustard.
steps: Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil, add the pasta shells and cook according to the packet instructions until tender.
Meanwhile, melt the butter in a saucepan over a medium heat. Stir in the cornstarch and cook for one minute, stirring constantly.
Gradually whisk in the milk, a little at a time, until smooth and combined.
Bring the sauce to a gentle simmer, stirring often, until it thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon.
Remove from the heat and stir in the grated Cheddar until melted, then add the mustard, salt and pepper.
Drain the cooked pasta and return it to the pan. Pour over the cheese sauce and stir gently until every shell is coated.
